prompt:
Rewrite snippets/blog-post-meta.liquid so it renders a blog post's meta line. The snippet must handle null, empty-string and whitespace-only inputs. INPUTS There is one top-level object `post`, never null. All four keys are always present: - `post.author`: string or null - `post.published_at`: string or null. It is an already formatted date such as "March 3, 2024". - `post.comments_count`: non-negative integer or null - `post.tags`: array of strings, or null. The array may be empty. Elements are never null but may be "" or whitespace-only. There are no section.settings. A string is "blank" when it is null, or empty after stripping leading and trailing whitespace. Non-blank strings are always displayed stripped and HTML-escaped with the standard escape (& < > " '). PARTS, in this order: 1. Author: if the author is not blank, output `By AUTHOR`. 2. Date: if published_at is not blank, output `DATE`. 3. Comments: if comments_count is not null, output `TEXT`, where TEXT is: - "No comments" for 0 - "1 comment" for 1 - "N comments" otherwise 4. Tags: - Walk the tags in order and skip blank tags. - The first 3 non-blank tags each become `
  • TAG
    • `. - If K more non-blank tags exist after those 3, append `
  • +K
    • `. Blank tags never count toward K. - If there is at least one non-blank tag, output `
      ` + items + `
    `. - Otherwise output nothing for this part, including when tags is null or empty. WRAPPER - If at least one part is output, wrap all parts in `
    ` ... `
    `. - If no part is output, the snippet outputs the empty string. Do not output an empty div. The output must be a single line with no whitespace or newlines between tags. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/blog-post-meta.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
